sourceDescription: Robot troop silhouettes developed from user-supplied references. Original authorship and publication were not independently verified.

approval.scope: The user authorized publishing all three robot troops after removal of the rear-view mech's central projection.
approval.evidence: once you have, you may ship these 3

/vector/troop/rear-view-battle-mech.svg.trace: Potrace 1.16, turdsize 12, alphamax 1.0, opttolerance 0.6, followed by SVG authoring root and provenance steps, uniform square normalization and the troop optimization profile.
/vector/troop/rear-view-battle-mech.svg.nativeEdits: The traced lower-back projection between the legs was removed directly from the compound path. Its contour was replaced by a shallow curve between the inner thighs. All other path segments were retained. The approved SVG master records the final geometry; the bitmap and tracing mask record the earlier tracing input.
/vector/troop/rear-view-battle-mech.svg.paint: Inherited from the caller. Structural gaps remain transparent.
/vector/troop/rear-view-battle-mech.svg.collection: Troops, supplied by the existing vector-category fallback.
/vector/troop/rear-view-battle-mech.svg.details: A rear-view armored robot has a broad high back, bent arms, a gun projecting to the left and two sturdy legs separated by a clear gap.
